title: When clicking on the current page, search should not go back to the first one (no toggle)
body:
This is an example of this behaviour on the tourism example.

![pagination-revert-bug](https://cloud.githubusercontent.com/assets/393765/18548598/de9385a6-7b49-11e6-976f-fbe9d749b9ab.gif)

comments.body:
I am unsure this is a default behavior we should implement, if I ctrl+click the third page that is already selected (new tab) I expect it to open the 3rd page in a new tab.

Here it would mean going to the first page.
Oups I should have mentionned that this is a bug :) And we should revert to the behaviour found in IS and basically all websites on internet when it comes to pagination.

While fixing this one, it actually triggered another bug which prevent the page from being reset when there is another filter that change its parameter. #workingOnASolution

see: https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/pull/1289
